name: Synergy-S Mo carbide production
notes: Settings taken from the validated seed_2 fit of 2026-09-30 (Rwp 2.03%,
GoF 3.32, weight and diffraction-area fractions agreeing to 0.1 points).
Quick constrained fit restricts the active parameters, which is what makes
refining Zero safe here: with cell, Uiso and XYZ held back, Zero cannot
trade against them the way it did in the unconstrained runs.
Y is fixed from the instrument file and constrained non-negative. A free Y
went negative on these samples, which is unphysical: it asks for peaks
narrower than the instrument can produce.
